metadata.title: SAWAN Food Festival and Hariyali Teej Celebrations @BIMTECHGreaterNoida I WoW - War on Food Waste
metadata.description:
Get Ready for an Exciting Journey with BIMTECH! 🚀
Admissions are now OPEN for the 2024-26 batch! 🎉

BIMTECH offers Two-Year Full-Time Residential PGDM Programs which are AACSB accredited, AICTE Approved, and Equivalent to an MBA.

Starting this year, we are launching a new PGDM program in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science—an advanced course that holds the approval of AICTE.

Your path to success begins here!" 🌟
Apply today - t.ly/Oe1iG

On the occasion of Hariyali Teej, a major North Indian festival, the Birla Institute Of Management Technology (BIMTECH) organized a grand celebration and invited us to join in the gala festivities. The highlight of the event was the Sawan food festival, which aimed to showcase the seasonal delicacies of the monsoon.

Established in 1988, Birla Institute of Management Technology (BIMTECH), located in Greater Noida, the National Capital Region, is one of the top MBA colleges to study in India and provides a highly conducive academic environment. Apart from their brilliant academic legacy, we were impressed by some really wonderful initiatives that we witnessed in different departments.

This event was conducted by the Food Conduit, one of the student-driven clubs of the Institute, 
 which looks after the overall food-related activities on the fully residential campus.

We first took a tour of their grand campus with some student representatives. As we strolled through the campus, we witnessed students preparing for an evening function. Every corner was adorned with decorations, creating an enchanting atmosphere.

After an enriching meeting with the Director, Dr. Harivansh Chaturvedi, who treated us to delicious ghewar from Mathura, we joined everyone for the evening full of song, dance, and other scintillating performances. 

Food court was up where there were chaat, golgappe, fritters, sweets, kulcha, puri, chole etc. We loved the spread, especially the bedmi puri with aalu ka rassa and the ghewar. Check out the full episode to know more about this wonderful day.
